question.problem: Given that $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{5}{12}),$ compute $P(4<X<7)$ rounded to $4$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{5}{12}),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{(\frac{7}{12})}^{x-1}(\frac{5}{12}), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(4<X<7) & =P(X\in \{5,6\}) \\  & =P(X=5)+P(X=6) \\  & =f(5)+f(6) \\  & ={(\frac{7}{12})}^{4}(\frac{5}{12})+{(\frac{7}{12})}^{5}(\frac{5}{12}) \\  & ≈0.0764.\end{aligned}
$$
